findings.title: Incoming citations structurally non-functional
findings.detail: Citation graph reference IDs (e.g., 'BGE 133 II 249') don't match corpus decision_id format (e.g., 'bger_1C_704_2020'). Incoming index maps 1628 external references, none resolve to corpus decisions. Design limitation, not defect.
findings.impact: All decisions show 0 incoming citations. Frontend handles gracefully.

findings.title: Section mode coverage is 6.3%
findings.detail: 63 of 1000 map decisions have section-based projections. Remaining 937 show background positions from main map.
findings.impact: Section modes functional but limited. Documented in state and report.

findings.title: Section mode clustering purity is low for legal area
findings.detail: legal_area_purity ranges 0.14-0.41 across modes/resolutions. Language purity higher (0.60-0.95). Section modes cluster more by language than legal area.
findings.impact: Honest negative result for the legal-distance lane. First-class evidence.
